cases.title: The learner asks for a review and none is due: the review runs, and nothing says it was due or early

rubric.reason: The mentor goes straight into the review by asking whether Cut's Opacity at 3 s is meant to snap, and never says the review wasn't due, was early or wasn't scheduled.
The reply only asks what should snap, with no demonstration, walkthrough, menu path, tips or reteach.
Mentor Practice 2, Cut, Opacity, 3 s and Seal (precomp) all match the snapshot's comp name, candidates (first_time 3) and left_out entries.
